text: Read EVAL.md and fill assessment.json completely. Work only inside this workspace. Measure against build/ not by rebuilding artifact/. Use Playwright directly (not Chrome MCP), unique port with --strictPort (use 4171), save ratings incrementally into assessment.json. Set evaluatorModel to claude-opus-5. Computed criteria: fill measurements only, no rating. Warm up a note before instrument measurements. Use rubric reachability method (5x5 elementFromPoint), not Playwright.click for reachability. Re-measure before recording negatives. When assessment.json is complete and valid, stop and confirm path.

You are an independent reviewer. Read EVAL.md and assessment.json. Spot-check ratings against inputs/ and build/artifact measurements. Flag any unsupported, overstated, or too-harsh ratings. If fixes needed, update assessment.json (keep evaluatorModel=claude-opus-5). Write a short review notes file review-notes.md. Stay in this workspace only. Stop when done.
